This is a potential underbilling of USD 15,372.97 across 18 invoice lines (2024-07-05 to 2025-12-05), with estimated recoverable USD 14,004.78.", "rebill_note_subject": "F-015 Coralstone Data Inc (C-2017, HTC-2003): potential underbilling, missed escalation – rebill review", "rebill_note_body": "Internal review note – not for customer distribution.

Finding F-015: Potential underbilling on contract C-2017, SKU HTC-2003, for Coralstone Data Inc.

Root cause: the contractual annual price escalation was never applied in billing.

Basis: Clause A.1 (page 3) sets the price at USD 129.75 per unit. Clause 4.2 (page 1) provides for annual Unit Price revisions from July 1, 2024, subject to a 1.5% minimum and 4% maximum.

Calculation: USD 129.75 (base price) x (1 + 3.4%) [2024-07-01] x (1 + 2.9%) [2025-07-01] = USD 138.05. The latest billed unit price is USD 129.75.

Impact: 18 invoice lines, 2024-07-05 to 2025-12-05. Potential underbilling is USD 15,372.97. Estimated recoverable amount is USD 14,004.78.

Proposed actions (for approval):
1. Pricing & Billing Master Data to load the escalated Unit Price into the billing price master from 2024-07-05.
2. Prepare a supplementary invoice for the under-billed lines.

No action will be taken until a human approver confirms."}
